impl LaneDrain {
    fn drain_controls_for_lane(&mut self) {
        for _ in 0..self
            .control_lane_consumer_for_this_strip
            .capacity_of_the_ring_in_records_total()
        {
            let Ok(record) = self.control_lane_consumer_for_this_strip.try_pop() else {
                break;
            };
            self.apply(record);
        }
    }
}
